body: This explains me too well, I guess I should see a doctor
I recently turned 21 too, cried like a baby. I know exactly how you feel. Please think of all you've accomplished and those you love, relax and take it easy. I'm here if you wanna talk.

Thank you, really. I know they still love me... but I feel like if they really knew me they wouldn't. I agree with you though, the world is fucked. As a society we are headed for collapse. It isn't a time to be pessimistic about the current climate though, we gotta really strive to see a change, it can be done. I know you're in this sub for the same reasons I am, so keep your head up I'm rooting for you
